rca of the issue: Iteration 13 addresses two follow-up polish bugs from iteration 12: (A) Even after fixing the beige splash by moving manifest bg/theme to #ffffff, the icon PNGs themselves still had opaque-white backgrounds, so on any non-white surface (dark launcher, colored splash) the icons showed a white plate around the wordmark. Fix: regenerate all 6 icons with a truly transparent (RGBA 0,0,0,0) canvas — verified on disk and when served over HTTPS from the preview URL: all report alpha min=0. (B) On several pages the logo image was not wrapped in a link to home, so users couldn't click the logo to return to the landing page. Fix: every page (Landing, LoginPage, ExamplesPage, ManifestPage, EthicsPage, PricingPage, PaymentStatusPage, AppShell/protected routes) now wraps in ; Footer additionally has data-testid="footer-logo-link". Logo.jsx itself was reduced to a pure to prevent nested / from any of these wrappers. Verified via source scanning (regex) AND runtime Playwright checks (querySelectorAll a[href="/"] for img[alt="Bragarmål"] on all 12 routes, followed by click-and-assert-url-is-root).
